column3: The Hebrew describes taking a contribution for Him and repeats “My contribution.”
The Hebrew names tachash skins, without explicitly calling them “fine leather.”
The Hebrew says “oil,” without expressly identifying olive oil.
The Hebrew repeats “pattern”: the pattern of the dwelling and the pattern of all its furnishings.
The Hebrew term denotes an atonement covering, rendered “mercy seat.”
The Hebrew explicitly says to make the cherubim “from the covering” at its two ends, without separately repeating gold in this verse.
The Hebrew describes vessels used for pouring, without expressly repeating “drink offerings.”
